One entry per GUI.Forms registry type (plus Control, Component and Window), then one per Windows Forms control or UI component with no GUI.Forms type. Members are the type's own: inherited ones are on the base's entry. A Windows Forms name qualified with a type (TextBoxBase.SelectAll) is declared by a Windows Forms base and declared by this GUI.Forms type.

status: supported, deferred, excluded or unclassified. basis: test (evidence names the test file that calls the member or overrides it in a subclass), catalogue (the stage W catalogue's exclusion), type (the type is excluded), w-brief, owner or coordinator (a written decision; evidence names it), none (unclassified; question says why). scope is the catalogue's: admitted, excluded or review.

Override rows of the Windows Forms catalogue are not listed: the member belongs to the declaring type. Nested Windows Forms types (collections, sub-items) and the item, cell and band types (ITEM_TYPES) follow the controls, unclassified until a GUI.Forms type stands for them.
